title: अंश १ · अध्याय २०

items.text:
एवं सञ्चिन्तयन् विष्णुमभोदेनात्मनो द्रिज ।
त्मयत्वमवाप्याग्रय मेने चात्मानमच्युतम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ sañcintayan viṣṇumabhodenātmano drija |
tmayatvamavāpyāgraya mene cātmānamacyutam || 1 ||

items.text:
विसस्मार तथात्मानं नान्यत् किञ्चिदजानत ।
अहमेवाव्ययोऽनन्तः परमात्मेत्यचिन्तयत् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
visasmāra tathātmānaṃ nānyat kiñcidajānata |
ahamevāvyayo'nantaḥ paramātmetyacintayat || 2 ||

items.text:
तस्य तदभावनायोगात् क्षीणापापस्य वे क्रमात् ।
शुद्ध ऽन्तः करणो विष्णुस्तस्थौ ज्ञानमयेऽच्युतः ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
tasya tadabhāvanāyogāt kṣīṇāpāpasya ve kramāt |
śuddha 'ntaḥ karaṇo viṣṇustasthau jñānamaye'cyutaḥ || 3 ||

items.text:
योगप्रभावात् प्रह्लादि जाते विष्णुमयेऽसुरे ।
चलत्युरगबन्धैस्तैर्म्मैत्रय त्रटितं क्षणात् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
yogaprabhāvāt prahlādi jāte viṣṇumaye'sure |
calatyuragabandhaistairmmaitraya traṭitaṃ kṣaṇāt || 4 ||

items.text:
भ्रान्तग्राहगणः सोर्म्मर्ययौ क्षोभ महार्णवः ।
चचाल च मही सर्वा सशौलवनकानना ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
bhrāntagrāhagaṇaḥ sormmaryayau kṣobha mahārṇavaḥ |
cacāla ca mahī sarvā saśaulavanakānanā || 5 ||

items.text:
स च तं शेलमम्पातं दैत्यैर्न्यस्तमथोपरि ।
प्रक्षिप्य तस्मात् सलिलान्निश्चक्राम महामतिः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
sa ca taṃ śelamampātaṃ daityairnyastamathopari |
prakṣipya tasmāt salilānniścakrāma mahāmatiḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
दृष्ट्वा च स जगदू भूयो गगनाद्यु पलक्षणम् ।
प्रह्लदोऽस्मीति सस्मार पुनरात्मानमात्मना ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
dṛṣṭvā ca sa jagadū bhūyo gaganādyu palakṣaṇam |
prahlado'smīti sasmāra punarātmānamātmanā || 7 ||

items.text:
तुष्टाव च पुनर्धीमाननादिं पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
एकाग्रमतिरव्यग्रो यतवाक्कायमानसः ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
tuṣṭāva ca punardhīmānanādiṃ puruṣottamam |
ekāgramatiravyagro yatavākkāyamānasaḥ || 8 ||

items.text:
ऊँ नमः परमार्थार्थ स्थूलसूक्ष्मक्षराक्षर ।
व्यक्ताव्यक्त कलातीत सकलेश निरंञ्जन ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
ūm̐ namaḥ paramārthārtha sthūlasūkṣmakṣarākṣara |
vyaktāvyakta kalātīta sakaleśa niraṃñjana || 9 ||

items.text:
गुणाञ्जन गुणाधार निर्गुणात्मन् गुणस्थिर ।
मूर्त्तामूर्त्त महामूर्त्ते सूक्ष्ममूर्त्ते स्फुटास्फुट ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
guṇāñjana guṇādhāra nirguṇātman guṇasthira |
mūrttāmūrtta mahāmūrtte sūkṣmamūrtte sphuṭāsphuṭa || 10 ||

items.text:
करालसौम्यरूपात्मन् विद्याविद्यालयाच्युत ।
सदसद्रूप सद्भाव सदसद्भावभावन ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
karālasaumyarūpātman vidyāvidyālayācyuta |
sadasadrūpa sadbhāva sadasadbhāvabhāvana || 11 ||

items.text:
नित्यानित्यप्रपञ्जात्मन् निष्प्रपञ्चामालश्रित ।
एकानिक नमस्तुभ्यं वासुदेवादिकारण ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
nityānityaprapañjātman niṣprapañcāmālaśrita |
ekānika namastubhyaṃ vāsudevādikāraṇa || 12 ||

items.text:
यः स्थूलसूक्ष्मः प्रकटः प्रकाशो
यःसर्व्भूतो न च सर्व्वभूतः ।
विश्वं यतश्चैतदविश्वहेतो
र्नमोऽस्तु तस्मै पुरुषोत्तमाय ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
yaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaḥ prakaṭaḥ prakāśo
yaḥsarvbhūto na ca sarvvabhūtaḥ |
viśvaṃ yataścaitadaviśvaheto
rnamo'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya || 13 ||

items.text:
तस्य तच्चेतसो देवः स्तुतिमित्थं प्रकूर्वतः ।
आविर्बभूव भगवान् पीताम्बरधरो हरिः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
tasya taccetaso devaḥ stutimitthaṃ prakūrvataḥ |
āvirbabhūva bhagavān pītāmbaradharo hariḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
ससम्भ्रमस्तमालोक्य समुत्थायाकुलाक्षरम् ।
नमोऽस्तु विष्णवेत्यतद व्याजहारासकृद द्रिज ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
sasambhramastamālokya samutthāyākulākṣaram |
namo'stu viṣṇavetyatada vyājahārāsakṛda drija || 15 ||

items.text:
देव प्रपन्नार्त्तिहर प्रसादं कुरु केशव ।
अवलोकनदानेन भूयो मां पावयाच्यत ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
deva prapannārttihara prasādaṃ kuru keśava |
avalokanadānena bhūyo māṃ pāvayācyata || 16 ||

items.text:
कुर्व्वतस्ते प्रसन्नोऽहं भक्तिमव्यभिचारिणीम् ।
यथाभिलषितो मत्तः प्रह्लाद व्रियतां वरः ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
kurvvataste prasanno'haṃ bhaktimavyabhicāriṇīm |
yathābhilaṣito mattaḥ prahlāda vriyatāṃ varaḥ || 17 ||

items.text:
नाथ योनिसहस्त्रेषु येषु येषु व्रजाम्यहम् ।
तेषु तेष्वच्युता भक्तिरच्युतास्तु सदा त्वयि ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
nātha yonisahastreṣu yeṣu yeṣu vrajāmyaham |
teṣu teṣvacyutā bhaktiracyutāstu sadā tvayi || 18 ||

items.text:
या प्रीतिरविवेकानां विषयेष्वनपायिनी ।
त्वामनुस्मरतः सा मे ह्टदयान्माऽपसर्पतु ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
yā prītiravivekānāṃ viṣayeṣvanapāyinī |
tvāmanusmarataḥ sā me hṭadayānmā'pasarpatu || 19 ||

items.text:
मयि भक्तिस्तवास्त्येव भूयोऽप्येवं भविष्यति ।
वरस्तु मत्तः प्रह्लाद व्रियतां यस्तवेप्सितः ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
mayi bhaktistavāstyeva bhūyo'pyevaṃ bhaviṣyati |
varastu mattaḥ prahlāda vriyatāṃ yastavepsitaḥ || 20 ||

items.text:
मयि द्र षानुबन्धोऽभूत् संस्तूतावुद्यते तव ।
मतूपितुस्तत्कृतं पापं देव तस्य प्रणश्यतु ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
mayi dra ṣānubandho'bhūt saṃstūtāvudyate tava |
matūpitustatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ deva tasya praṇaśyatu || 21 ||

items.text:
शस्त्राणि पातितान्यङ्ग क्षिप्तो यज्वाग्रिसंहतौ ।
दंशितश्चोरगैर्दृत्तं यद्रिषं मम भोजने ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
śastrāṇi pātitānyaṅga kṣipto yajvāgrisaṃhatau |
daṃśitaścoragairdṛttaṃ yadriṣaṃ mama bhojane || 22 ||

items.text:
बद्ध्वा समुद्र यत् क्षिप्तो यज्वितोऽस्मि शलोच्चयाः ।
अन्यानि चाप्यसाधूनि यानि यानि कृतानि मे ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
baddhvā samudra yat kṣipto yajvito'smi śaloccayāḥ |
anyāni cāpyasādhūni yāni yāni kṛtāni me || 23 ||

items.text:
त्वयि भक्तिमतो द्रेषादघं तत्सम्भवञ्च यत् ।
त्वतूप्रसादात् प्रभो सद्यस्तेन मुच्येत मेपिता ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
tvayi bhaktimato dreṣādaghaṃ tatsambhavañca yat |
tvatūprasādāt prabho sadyastena mucyeta mepitā || 24 ||

items.text:
प्रह्लाद सर्व्वमेतत् ते मत्प्रसादादू भविष्यति ।
अन्यञ्च ते वरं दह्मि व्रियतामसुरात्मज ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
prahlāda sarvvametat te matprasādādū bhaviṣyati |
anyañca te varaṃ dahmi vriyatāmasurātmaja || 25 ||

items.text:
कृतकृत्योऽस्मि भगवन् वरेणानेन यत् त्वयि ।
भवित्री त्वत्प्रसादेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
kṛtakṛtyo'smi bhagavan vareṇānena yat tvayi |
bhavitrī tvatprasādena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī || 26 ||

items.text:
धर्म्मर्थकामैः किं तस्य मुक्तिस्तस्य करो स्थिता ।
समस्तजगतां मूले यस्य भक्तिः स्थिरा त्वयि ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
dharmmarthakāmaiḥ kiṃ tasya muktistasya karo sthitā |
samastajagatāṃ mūle yasya bhaktiḥ sthirā tvayi || 27 ||

items.text:
यथा ते निश्चलं चेतो मयि भक्तिसमन्वितम ।
तथा त्वं मत्प्रसादेन निव्वाणा परमाप्स्यसि ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
yathā te niścalaṃ ceto mayi bhaktisamanvitama |
tathā tvaṃ matprasādena nivvāṇā paramāpsyasi || 28 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दृ धे विष्णुस्तस्य मैत्रेय ! पश्यतः ।
स चापि पुनरागम्य ववन्दे चरणौ पितुः ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktvāntardṛ dhe viṣṇustasya maitreya ! paśyataḥ |
sa cāpi punarāgamya vavande caraṇau pituḥ || 29 ||

items.text:
तं पिता मूद्ध न्युपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य च पीडिताम् ।
जीवसीत्याह वत्सेति बाष्पार्द्र नयनो द्रिज ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
taṃ pitā mūddha nyupāghrāya pariṣvajya ca pīḍitām |
jīvasītyāha vatseti bāṣpārdra nayano drija || 30 ||

items.text:
प्रीतिमांस्वाभवत् तस्मिन्ननुतापी महासुरः ।
गुरुपित्रोश्वकारैवं शुश्वूषां सोऽपि धर्म्मवित् ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
prītimāṃsvābhavat tasminnanutāpī mahāsuraḥ |
gurupitrośvakāraivaṃ śuśvūṣāṃ so'pi dharmmavit || 31 ||

items.text:
पितर्य्युपरतिं नीते नरसिंहस्वरूपिणा ।
विष्णुना सोऽपिदैत्यानां मैत्रयाभूत् परिस्ततः ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
pitaryyuparatiṃ nīte narasiṃhasvarūpiṇā |
viṣṇunā so'pidaityānāṃ maitrayābhūt paristataḥ || 32 ||

items.text:
ततो राज्यद्यु तिं प्राप्य कर्म्मशुद्धिकरीं द्रिज ।
पुत्रपौत्रांश्व सुबहुनवाप्यैश्वय्येमेव च ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
tato rājyadyu tiṃ prāpya karmmaśuddhikarīṃ drija |
putrapautrāṃśva subahunavāpyaiśvayyemeva ca || 33 ||

items.text:
क्षीणाधिकारःस यदा पुण्यपापविवर्जितः ।
तदासौ भगवदूध्यानात् परं निर्व्वणमाप्तवान ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
kṣīṇādhikāraḥsa yadā puṇyapāpavivarjitaḥ |
tadāsau bhagavadūdhyānāt paraṃ nirvvaṇamāptavāna || 34 ||

items.text:
एवम्प्रभावो दैत्योऽसौ मैत्रेयासीनूमहामतिः ।
प्रह्लादो भगवदूभक्तो यं त्वं मामनुपृच्छसि ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
evamprabhāvo daityo'sau maitreyāsīnūmahāmatiḥ |
prahlādo bhagavadūbhakto yaṃ tvaṃ māmanupṛcchasi || 35 ||

items.text:
यस्त्वेतच्चरितं तस्य प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः ।
श्वृणोति त्सय पापानि सद्या गच्छन्ति संक्षयम् ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
yastvetaccaritaṃ tasya prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ |
śvṛṇoti tsaya pāpāni sadyā gacchanti saṃkṣayam || 36 ||

items.text:
अहोरात्रकृतं पापं प्रह्लादचरितं नरः ।
श्वृणवन् पठंश्व मैत्रेय व्यपोहति न संशयः ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prahlādacaritaṃ naraḥ |
śvṛṇavan paṭhaṃśva maitreya vyapohati na saṃśayaḥ || 37 ||

items.text:
पौर्णामास्याममावस्यामष्टम्यामथवा पठन् ।
द्रादश्यां वा तदाप्नोति गोप्रदानफलं द्रिज ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
paurṇāmāsyāmamāvasyāmaṣṭamyāmathavā paṭhan |
drādaśyāṃ vā tadāpnoti gopradānaphalaṃ drija || 38 ||

items.text:
प्रह्लादं सकलापत्सु यथा रक्षितवान् हरिः ।
तथा रक्षति यस्तस्य श्वृणोति चरितं सदा ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
prahlādaṃ sakalāpatsu yathā rakṣitavān hariḥ |
tathā rakṣati yastasya śvṛṇoti caritaṃ sadā || 39 ||

en_chapter: Parāçara said:—O twice-born! Thus meditating upon Vishnu as identical with himself he attained to that unification, which is desired by all and regarded him as the undecaying divinity. He forgot his individuality and was not conscious of anything. And he thought that he himself was the endless, undecaying supreme soul. And on account of this efficient notion of identity, the undecaying Vishnu, whose essence is wisdom, appeared in his mind which was wholly purified from sin. When the Asura Prahlāda had become identified with Vishnu by virtue of contemplation all the bonds were at once severed, as soon as he shook. The mighty deep rose up in waves and the monsters therein were terrified. And the earth trembled with all her mountains and forests. And throwing aside the pile of rocks that were placed by the Daityas on his breast, the high-minded Prahlāda came out of waters. And beholding the outer world, earth and heaven, he remembered who he was and knew himself to be Prahlāda. And again the wise boy, with his mind solely devoted to him and controlling his mind and speech, sang the glory of that excellent Purusha who is without beginning: Prahlāda said,—"Salutation unto thee who art the true wisdom, who art subtile and substantial, mutable and immutable, perceptible and unperceptible, who art with form and without it, indescribable and describable. Thou art the asylum of all attributes; thou art without qualities and with them; thou art with shape and without it; thou art minute and vast; visible and invisible; thou art hideousness and beauty; O undecaying Hari! thou art wisdom and ignorance. Thou art cause and effect; existence and non-existence; thou dost comprise all that is good and evil; thou art the substance of all perishable and imperishable elements and the refuge of all undeveloped rudiments. Salutation unto thee who art both one and many, Vāsudeva and the first cause of all. Salutation unto that excellent Purusha, who is both large and small, manifest and hidden, who is present in all beings and not, and from whom proceeds the universe although distinct from universal cause". Parāçara said:—While with his mind thus devoted to Vishnu Prahlāda chanted his praises; the Great Hari, clad in yellow suddenly appeared before him. Beholding him, he respectfully rose and with hesitating speech exclaimed repeatedly "Glory unto Vishnu" and said,—"O thou who removest the affliction of thy followers, O Keshava, do thou be propitious unto me. Do thou again purify me, O eternal god, with thy sight". The Deity replied,—"I am propitiated with thee for thy unshaken devotion unto me. Ask of me, Prahlāda, whatever thou wishest". Prahlāda said,—"My faith in thee may never suffer decrease in all the thousand births through which I may be doomed to pass. May my devotion unto thee be as firm as the attachment cherished by the ignorant people towards all worldly objects". The Deity replied,—"Thou hast already devotion unto me—and it shall ever be the same; but do thou beg of me a boon, O Prahlāda, whatever thou wishest". Prahlāda said,—"My father has treated me malignantly for proclaiming thy praises. O lord, do thou remove the sin he hath thus committed. He assailed me with weapons—he had me thrown into fire, bitten by the serpents, had poison mixed up with my viands, had me cast into the deep in bonds, and buried down with rocks and many other ills he had wrought against me out of malice for being devoted unto thee. May my father, O lord, by thy mercy, be speedily relieved of the sin he hath thus committed". The Deity replied,—"Prahlāda, all this shall be accomplished by my mercy. I wish to confer upon thee another boon, O son of Asura, do thou beg it". Prahlāda said,—"All my desires, O lord, have been fulfilled by the boon thou hast conferred upon me, that my faith in thee may never suffer decrease. What to speak of wealth, virtue or desire, even emancipation is in his hands who has firm devotion in thee, the root of the universal world". The Deity said,—"As unshaken is thy devotion unto me thou shalt by my mercy obtain final emancipation from existence". Parāçara said:—Having said this Vishnu disappeared from his sight, O Maitreya and Prahlāda again went to his father and bowed down before him. Having smelt his forehead, embraced him and shed tears, the father said, "Dost thou live my child?" The Great Asura treated him with kindness and repented for his past actions. And Prahlāda, conversant with piety, attended diligently upon his father and preceptor. After his father had been slain by Vishnu in the form of the man-lion, he became, O Maitreya, the sovereign of the Daityas. And obtaining the splendours of royalty on account of piety, he came by immense wealth and was blessed, with a numerous progeny. At the expiration of the regal power and freed from the consequences of moral merit or demerit, he obtained, by virtue of his meditation of the deity final emancipation from future births. So powerful was the wise Daitya Prahlāda devoted to Vishnu, O Maitreya, about whom you asked me. Whoever listens to the story of Prahlāda, is speedily freed from all sins. Forsooth a man is released from the iniquities he commits day and night by once hearing or reading the history of Prahlāda. The reading of this history, on the day of full-moon, of new-moon or in the eighth and twelfth days of the lunar half month, shall offer fruit tantamount to the gift of a cow, O twice born one. As Hari protected Prahlāda in all his calamities so he shall protect him who constantly listens to his history.
